name: Air Elemental
description: An elemental is a powerful fusion of raw magic and elements resulting in a formidable foe that can channel magic. Elementals are typically prevalent in groups and in locations that are infused with ancient magic or extraplanar energy.

actions.name: Thundering Strikes
actions.description: The Air Elementaling channels pure thunder into kinetic strikes, dealing physical and lightning damage.

actions.name: Static Burst
actions.description: The Air Elemental causes a burst of electricity to strike all adjacent targets, dealing lightning damage. On a true hit, all creatures who take lightning damage gain the dazed condition.

actions.name: Shifting Wind
actions.description: The Air Elemental spends some of it's essence and dissolves into a wind and reforms at a location within 8 units. Until the end of it's turn, it gains a 1d4 bonus to attack checks. The Air Elemental takes 1d4 true damage after using this action.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the Air Elemental's area of control, it makes an attack against them with it's Thundering Strikes action.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Air
traits.description: If the Air Elementaling does not move or attack for one minute, it becomes invisible until it makes its next attack.
